data.name: Taite
data.gender_notes: Taite is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Taite was a goddess of childbirth and deliverance. In Christianity, the name Taite is derived from the Aramaic word ‘Taitha’, meaning ‘to be steadfast’ or ‘to endure’. The name Taite is a powerful reminder of God’s deliverance and salvation. The name Taite carries the meaning “Deliverer, Savior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Taite usually hope their child will grow to embody deliverer, savior and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Taite total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
